mortal_cultivation.race.wastelander_race: A cultivator whose meridians have been sealed, leaving spiritual energy unable to flow freely. Known as Fèi Rén—a wasted person—among those who judge worth by cultivation, you begin with a crippled foundation, not a finished fate. Through perseverance, rare medicines, and hard-won insight, you may yet find a way to break the seal.

mortal_cultivation.race.monkey_race.desc: Born in a spiritually blessed land, this nimble Monkey is only beginning to awaken its intelligence. Quick hands, sure-footed movement, and a stubborn will help it survive among stronger creatures. Through cultivation and hard-won trials, this humble primate can refine its spirit, master martial arts, and ascend toward the power of legendary stone-born sages.
